_: AXXA — Brand to Know. 18 locked picks + verified brand facts.
_date: All prices and stock read from axxa.com.au on 20 September 2026.
_CURRENCY_WARNING: READ THIS BEFORE TOUCHING A PRICE. axxa.com.au runs Shopify Markets and geolocates. From a US IP the whole storefront — INCLUDING /products.json and /products/<handle>.js — serves prices auto-converted to USD at rate 0.72652152. The Golf-Surf Club Hoodie reads '$87' that way; AXXA's own price is A$119. Appending ?country=AU to the same endpoints returns the real AUD figures, which is what is recorded below. Nothing here was converted by us; every number was read from their store in their own currency. If these are ever refreshed, refresh them WITH ?country=AU or every price on the page silently drops about 27%.

facts.founder: Axel. AXXA publishes a first name only and describes him as 14 at founding, which puts him around 17-18 now. EDITORIAL NOTE: report only what AXXA publishes about him. Do not go looking for a surname, school, town or exact age, and do not build the piece around his age as a novelty.
facts.base: Sydney's Northern Beaches, New South Wales
facts.positioning: Coastal lifestyle brand sitting between surf and golf. Their own word is 'youth-driven'.
facts.core_lines: Golf-Surf Club (abbreviated AGSC on product art), Manly Country Club, Founders Collection, Chasing Landscapes
facts.manufacturing: Product pages state 'Made in PRC' plainly on the knits, hoodies and tees. Report it as the neutral fact they disclose.
facts.own_fabric: Polos use what they call Axxa GolfComfort — a polyester/spandex blend they describe as moisture-wicking and quick-drying.
facts.knit_construction: The three knits use jacquard-knitted motifs rather than printed or appliqued graphics, at stated weights of 980g, 730g and 550g.
facts.catalogue_size: 48 products listed, of which 4 are store furniture (gift card, shipping protection, an insurance checkbox, one untitled item).
facts.sold_out_at_check: Manly Country Club Zip Up Polo, Baby Blue Staple Trackies, Blossom driver head cover, both stripe quarter-zips, Anchor Ace Polo. The driver head cover is their only headcover and it is out of stock — mention, don't feature.
facts.reviews: Site displays 4.98 from 99 reviews at time of checking. That is their own widget's figure; attribute it to them, do not present it as independent.

brand_copy._rule: These are AXXA's own site copy, not interview quotes, and there is no named individual speaking. Attribute to the brand, exactly as the Agronomy page does. Never present as something a person said to TGI.
brand_copy._source: https://www.axxa.com.au/ (Who are we? block) and the 3 Year Jersey product page
items: Axxa is a youth-driven coastal lifestyle brand born on Sydney's Northern Beaches, built in the space between surf, golf, and everyday life.
We're not defined by one sport or trend, we represent the coastal rhythm of surf, golf, mates, and living well, all in one day.
From a 14 year olds dream to a growing Axxa family across Australia and beyond
